name: Warp
description: Stretches or squeezes the spacing of the partials around a pivot note that stays put, so strings turn into bells and bells into dense beating clusters.

params.name: Stretch
params.description: Pulls the partials apart or pushes them together around the pivot. Up, a string turns to a bell; down, they crowd into a beating cluster. The middle leaves them alone.

params.name: Pivot
params.description: The pitch that does not move. Everything else is stretched away from it or squeezed toward it. With Follow on, the lowest pitch the pivot may land on.

params.name: Follow
params.description: On moves the pivot to the lowest strong partial being played at or above the Pivot setting, so each note of a single line keeps its pitch while its overtones move.

params.name: Lean
params.description: Which side of the pivot is warped. Turned up, only the partials above the pivot move; turned down, only those below it. The middle moves both.

params.name: Shift
params.description: Transposes the whole warped sound after the stretch, pivot included.

params.name: Drift
params.description: Lets the stretch wander slowly by itself, so the partials breathe in and out of tune like a bell turning in the air. Zero holds them still.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Leans the warped sound darker or brighter. Stretching throws partials upward, and turning this down takes the edge off them.

params.name: Width
params.description: Gives the left and right sides slightly different stretches, so each partial beats slowly between the speakers. At zero a mono sound stays mono.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the warped one. Part way, partials near the pivot beat slowly against their dry selves.

origin.note: A peak-locked phase vocoder on kit::Stft: every spectral peak and the bins around it are moved together to pivot x (f / pivot)^stretch.
